normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of every current, previously undecided text-bearing row two to five rows from an accepted redaction with only non-prose intervening rows. Accept only exact disposable spans proven by full-payload and import-preimage evidence; retain functional copy, title, identity, attribution, dedication, authored dialogue or narrative, source-significant context, structural lettering, and ambiguity.
